page.layout: One printed page, title block centred. Lines run from the top to the foot of the page, with no running head or page number.
page.notes: The "IN" line carries a decorative swash monogram in the scan, read here as IN. The faint "PRAEFATIO" heading and the faint text in the background are show-through from the reverse side and are left out. At the foot there is a faint mark that may be a gathering signature ("A 2"); it is too indistinct to be certain and is not transcribed. No engraving is printed.
